title: Cocktail Series: Bar Shoot
description: Beverage series for Capture Create Caffeinate. Dark bar, available practicals, one speedlight. The a7IV stayed on the body the whole night for its high-ISO performance.
body:
## Process

No C-stands on this job, so everything was handheld or balanced on the bar.
Key light from the speedlight bounced off the back bar, practicals doing the
rest. Shot wide open and let the highlights bloom.

## What I learned

In a real bar you light with what the room gives you. The shot list matters
less than reading the practicals in the first five minutes.

title: Building in Public: Episode 1
description: Pilot episode for the build-in-public series. Shot, edited, and graded in a single weekend to prove the workflow before committing to a schedule.
body:
## Process

One camera, one lens, available light. The point of the pilot was speed:
prove the full pipeline (shoot to upload) could happen inside a weekend,
then tighten from there.

## What I learned

Perfectionism is the bottleneck. Shipping the pilot with rough edges taught
more than another month of planning would have.
